# Results Index (results/)

> Measured outcomes per completed roadmap item. Full data in domain docs;
> roadmap rows carry a one-line summary only.

## Domain docs

| Doc | Records | State |
|-----|---------|-------|
| PERF.md | performance optimization effects (bench before/after) | active |
| BUG.md | bug-fix verification results | active |
| FEATURE.md | feature implementation verification | active |

<!-- generated by `w1mer build` — do not edit by hand -->

## Record fields (required)

- Roadmap id + domain id (e.g. `05.1`, `PERF_STRING B1`)
- commit hash + date
- measured data (bench before/after, pass counts)
- conclusion: `significant` `mild` `none` `regression`
- on regression: root-cause hypothesis + suggested next direction
